trigger.issue: state-by-window fixed-effect sensitivity returned non-finite SE/CI/p because the expanded fixed-effect design was not estimable

replacement_h3_sensitivity.rationale: Within four-window states, the shoulder main effect is exactly spanned by C(RunNumber), so the lower-order baseline shoulder contrast is already contained in the nuisance fixed-effect space.
replacement_h3_sensitivity.formula: prop ~ rain_z + rain_z:shoulder + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
replacement_h3_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity only; cannot upgrade the original H3 decision.

prohibited: no replacement of hierarchy-corrected primary H3 result
